boiled = cooked in hot water
fried = cooked in hot oil
grilled = cooked over or under strong heat
roast = cooked in an oven with fat, often for Sunday lunch
raw = not cooked
spicy = with a hot, strong flavour from spices
bitter = having a sharp taste, like strong coffee or dark chocolate
sour = having an acid taste, like lemon or vinegar
delicious = very pleasant to eat or drink
homemade = made at home, not bought in a shop
allergy = a medical problem caused by eating or touching something
cut down on = to eat or drink less of something
starving = extremely hungry
snack = a small amount of food between meals
breakfast = the first meal of the day
lunch = a meal in the middle of the day
dinner = the main meal in the evening
supper = a light evening meal
brunch = a late morning meal that replaces breakfast and lunch
hungry = wanting or needing food
